discountTotal.description: Staff-applied discount amount, e.g. a phone-negotiated deal

promoCode.description: A Promotion code to apply — validated for window/usage-limit/scope against this order

amount.description: Partial capture amount; omit to capture the full authorized amount

costPrice.description: Admin-only; never returned to customer-facing endpoints
Admin-only; never returned to customer-facing endpoints

delta.description: Positive to restock, negative to correct/deduct

isFeatured.description: Storefront "Best Seller" / featured badge — manually curated
Storefront "Best Seller" / featured badge — manually curated

discountValue.description: Percent (1-100) for percentage, dollar amount for fixed, ignored for free_shipping

scopeIds.description: Category or product ids — required when scope is not store_wide

refundApprovalThreshold.description: Refunds above this amount require a second staff member’s approval; unset disables the feature

announcementText.description: Public storefront announcement/message bar text; unset or empty disables the banner

password.description: Current account password — required only when replacing an already-enabled 2FA setup
Current account password, required to disable 2FA

challengeToken.description: The challengeToken returned by POST /auth/login when 2FA is required

permissionKeys.description: Replaces the role’s entire permission set

roleIds.description: Role ids to assign on creation
Replaces the user’s entire role assignment set

disableTwoFactor.description: Lost-device recovery: force-disables 2FA on this account (admin action, not self-service)

parentId.description: Set to reparent; null moves it to root. Omit to leave unchanged.

customerId.description: Link to an existing customer, if known

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer when adminResponse is set (default true when adminResponse is provided)

flatRate.description: Omit to defer to a live courier rate (not yet integrated)

sortOrder.description: First matching zone by this order wins

items.description: Free-form list of requested items, e.g. [{ "description": "25kg rice", "quantity": 50 }]

dealId.description: Weekly deal id — attaches its discount to this line. Omit for full price.

items.description: Must cover every item on the return, one condition each

price.description: Admin-set bundle price — not auto-computed from component prices

primaryCtaUrl.description: A path or full URL — not restricted to internal routes

secondaryCtaLabel.description: Set null to remove the secondary CTA

secondaryCtaUrl.description: Set null to remove the secondary CTA
